title: Getting Started
text:
# Getting Started

## Creating an account

Users can create an account by opening the registration page and entering their email address and password. The system sends a verification email before activating the account.

## Resetting a password

If a user forgets their password, they can select Forgot Password on the login page. A password reset link is sent to their registered email address. The link expires after 30 minutes.

## Contacting support

Users can contact support through the Help Center. They should include a description of the problem and any relevant error message.

title: Troubleshooting
text:
# Troubleshooting

## Login failures

If login fails, verify that the email address and password are correct. Check whether the account has been verified. If the issue continues, use the password reset option.

## Slow application performance

If the application responds slowly, check your network connection and try again. If the problem continues, contact support with the approximate time of the issue and the steps that caused it.

## File upload errors

If a file upload fails, confirm that the file type is supported and the file size is within the configured limit. Retry the upload. If the error persists, contact support and include the error message.
